create_randn_tensor: create a device-agnostic random tensor with specified shape, dtype, and optional per-batch seeding
apply_freeu: apply the FreeU mechanism to UNet hidden states and skip connections at a given resolution stage
enable_full_determinism: enable full deterministic behavior for reproducible PyTorch distributed training
get_device: get the best available PyTorch device string (cuda, xpu, npu, mps, mlu, or cpu)
lru_cache_unless_export: wrap a function with lru_cache that bypasses caching during torch.compile or torch.export
